Getting started

On this page
  • Install Taqwim
  • The first launch
  • The home screen
  • Change your location

This chapter covers installing Taqwim, the three steps of the first launch, the home screen, and how to change your location later.

Install Taqwim

Get Taqwim from the download page of this website. It lists each version and says which are ready now.

DeviceHow to install
Android phone or tabletGoogle Play, or the Android APK file from the download page
iPhone and iPadThe App Store only
Windows 10 and 11The Windows installer
Mac with Apple siliconThe macOS disk image (.dmg)
LinuxThe .deb package (Ubuntu, Debian) or the AppImage (any distribution)
Any computer or phoneThe web version, in the browser

Android

To install from Google Play:

  1. Open Google Play and search for Taqwim.
  2. Tap Install.

To install the APK file instead:

  1. Download the Android APK from the download page.
  2. Open the downloaded file. Android may ask you to allow installs from the app you used to open it; allow it for this install.
  3. Tap Install.

iPhone and iPad

Taqwim for iPhone and iPad is installed from the App Store only. It cannot be installed from GitHub or from a downloaded file.

Windows

  1. Download the Windows installer.
  2. Run it. It installs Taqwim for your Windows user only, without administrator rights, and adds a Start menu folder and a desktop shortcut.
  3. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose More info, then Run anyway. This appears because the installer is not code-signed yet.

To uninstall, use Windows Settings → Apps. Your Taqwim settings stay in your user profile (%APPDATA%\Taqwim), so a later reinstall finds them again.

macOS

  1. Download the macOS disk image and open it.
  2. Drag Taqwim into the Applications folder.
  3. The first time you open it, Control-click (or right-click) Taqwim and choose Open. Or open System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway. This is needed because the app is not notarised by Apple yet.

The macOS version is for Macs with Apple silicon.

Linux

  • Debian or Ubuntu: install the package with sudo apt install ./Taqwim-Linux-amd64.deb.
  • Any distribution: make the AppImage runnable with chmod +x Taqwim-Linux-x86_64.AppImage, then run it.

The web version

Open Web version on the download page. It keeps your settings in the browser's storage on that device. Compared with the apps, it has:

  • no prayer alerts, no Athan sounds and no own sounds;
  • no nearby mosques, directions or offline map areas;
  • "Use my location" only on a secure (https://) address.

The first launch

The first time Taqwim opens, it asks three questions. A counter at the top shows the step (1/3, 2/3, 3/3).

Step 1: Language

  1. Tap العربية for Arabic, English for English, or Same as the device to follow your device's language.
  2. Tap Continue.

You can change the language later in Settings.

Step 2: Location

Taqwim needs your location to compute the prayer times, the Qibla and the sky. It asks the device for its location as soon as this step opens; your device may ask you for permission first. The location is used on the device only and is never sent anywhere.

While it searches, you see Finding your location…. Then:

  • If a place is found, it is shown with its country and the words from GPS. If the name is a nearby village but you live in the town next to it, tap Not this place? and pick another place near the same point. Then tap Continue.
  • If no place is found (permission refused, a computer without location, or no answer in time), a message says why. Taqwim still shows a Current suggestion, guessed from your device's time zone. Tap Keep this place to use it, or Try GPS again.

Under Or set the place another way you can always:

  • tap Choose from the list to pick your country and then your city;
  • tap Enter coordinates to type the latitude and longitude, for example 21.4225, 39.8262 for Makkah.

The location messages mean:

MessageWhat to do
Location permission was refused.Allow location for Taqwim in the device settings, or choose from the list.
Location is not available on this device.Choose from the list or enter coordinates. Most computers have no GPS.
Timed out finding the location.Try again outdoors or near a window, or choose from the list.
This device has no location service.Choose from the list or enter coordinates.

Step 3: Prayer method

  1. Check Calculation method. Taqwim selects the method usually followed in your place's country; change it if your mosque follows another.
  2. Choose the Asr time: Standard (the majority opinion) or Hanafi.
  3. Tap Finish.

On Android, iPhone and iPad, Taqwim then asks for permission to show notifications, because prayer alerts are on by default. See Alerts and the Athan.

The method and the Asr time can be changed later in Settings → Prayer. See Prayer times.

The home screen

The bar at the top of every screen shows:

  • your country's two-letter code, the place's name and its neighbourhood or country. Tap the name to change the place;
  • the magnifier, which also opens the place search;
  • the settings button (sliders), which opens Settings;
  • on every screen except the first, a back arrow. On a computer, the Esc key also goes back; on Android, the system back gesture does.

The home screen has these tiles:

TileWhat it opens
CalendarPrayer times, the month calendar and all the astronomy modes (Prayer times, Calendar, Sky, Moon and astronomy)
Qibla locatorThe Qibla direction, the Sun method and the Qibla map (The Qibla)
2D compassA compass with the Qibla, the Sun and the Moon
3D compassThe local sky as a ball you can turn
Sky sphereThe Sun, the Moon, the planets and the stars in 3-D
Islamic occasionsThe occasions of the Hijri year
Astronomical calculatorYear cycles, the Moon at a moment, a historical day (The Astronomical Calculator)

To open the app on another screen than the home screen, see Start screen in Settings.

Change your location

Search for a place

  1. Tap the place name in the top bar, or the magnifier.
  2. Type a city or country in Search for a city or country. Names work in Arabic and English. Or tap a country under Countries to list its places; tap countries to go back to the list.
  3. Tap the place.

Or tap Use my location at the top to use the device's GPS.

When you pick a new place, the previous one is kept under Favourites in Settings → Location (up to 20 places), so you can switch back quickly.

If the new place is in another country whose usual method is different, a line under the top bar offers it, for example "Prayer method for Egypt: Egyptian Authority. Use it?". Tap Use to switch, or Keep to keep your method.

From Settings → Location

Settings → Location shows the Current place, its Latitude, Longitude, Elevation, Time zone (with its offset from UTC) and Source (how the place was set). Its buttons:

  • Change: opens the place search.
  • Choose on the map: pick a point on the map.
  • Enter coordinates: type a latitude and longitude.
  • Edit by hand: correct the latitude, longitude and Elevation (m, optional) of the current place, then tap Save.

Under Favourites, tap Use to make a favourite the current place, or Remove to delete it.

Choose on the map

  1. Open Settings → Location → Choose on the map.
  2. Tap the point you want. Or tap My location to go to your GPS position.
  3. A bar under the map shows the nearest named place and the coordinates. Tap Use this location, or Cancel to tap again.

Typing coordinates

Type the latitude first, then the longitude, separated by a comma or a space: 21.4225, 39.8262. Taqwim also understands hemisphere letters (21.4225 N, 39.8262 E), degrees-minutes-seconds and Arabic-Indic digits. Latitude must be between −90 and 90, longitude between −180 and 180, and elevation between −500 and 9000 metres.

If the place's time zone differs from your device's, Settings → Location says so: "This place uses the time zone …; times are shown in that zone." Taqwim always shows times in the place's own time zone, including daylight saving time.
